key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:0:0280
name: attach_handle_or_release
description: Allocates a handle through one library call, then passes that handle with the two arguments to a second call. If the second call fails, the handle is released and zero is returned; otherwise the handle is returned.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0000
name: read_record_into_allocated_node
description: Allocates a node, reads a record into a stack buffer through a library call, then copies ten longwords and eight further fields from the buffer into the node. A non-null link in the referenced structure is pointed back at the new node; a failed read releases the node and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:004A
name: copy_saved_fields_into_node
description: Copies ten longwords and eight further fields from the caller's saved block into the node. If one stored link is set, that linked structure's back-pointer is updated to point at the node; nothing is returned.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:009C
name: return_constant_zero
description: Does no work and returns zero immediately, so it is a stub in this shared library.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:00A8
name: copy_node_fields_to_header
description: Builds a header on the stack by writing a fixed two-word tag and copying ten longwords and several fields from the given node into it, then passes the header with the first two arguments to a library routine.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0124
name: read_info_file_into_icon
description: Builds a file name with the info suffix, opens the file, and reads a 78-byte icon header. It checks the header's magic value and version, then loads any image and string-list sections the header references, closing the file before returning.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0180
name: check_header_and_read_chunks
description: Checks the header just read for the expected magic value and version. If both match, it reads the image and string-list chunks the header references into newly allocated memory and returns one; any failed check or read returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:024A
name: read_optional_icon_sections
description: Stores two values read from the file into the node, then loads up to three optional sections, each allocated and filled through library calls. It returns one only when every read succeeds.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:033A
name: read_string_pointer_table
description: Reads a counted run of entries into a pointer table, checking each read for zero, then reads one further optional section. It returns one when all reads succeed and zero otherwise.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:03EE
name: discard_result_return_zero
description: Calls one routine, discards its result, and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:03F2
name: exit_without_action
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:03FE
name: load_info_file_into_node
description: Allocates a 260-byte scratch buffer, builds a file name by appending text, reads the icon header and loads the image and string sections it names into the node. It frees the buffer before returning, and reports an error and returns zero if the allocation fails.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:043E
name: read_icon_sections_from_handle
description: Saves one field of the node, reads the icon header through library calls and loads the optional sections it names into the node. It restores the saved field before returning one only if every read succeeds.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:04F2
name: read_icon_list_sections
description: Reads an optional counted value followed by two lists of pointers and one further optional value. It returns one when all reads succeed and restores a saved field in the node before returning.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0584
name: measure_and_send_string_entries
description: Advances through a counted string entry, then passes each entry in the node's list to a library call along with its length and contents. It sends one further optional value and returns one only if every call succeeds.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:05AC
name: send_string_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of pointers, sending each entry's length and text through library calls, and then sends one further optional value. It returns one when every call succeeds.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0656
name: walk_node_chain_from_field
description: Follows a chain of links that starts inside the given structure, passing each node to a library routine. It stops when the chain ends or returns to its head, and passes the final node to the routine once more.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0662
name: walk_linked_node_list
description: Walks a linked list by following the link stored in each node, calling a library routine on each node until the link is zero or the chain loops back to the start. If a node was found, the routine is called once more on the last one.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0692
name: forward_call_with_offset
description: Passes the first argument and the second argument advanced by a fixed 140-byte offset to a second routine, then returns nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:06A8
name: allocate_node_and_attach
description: Allocates a 168-byte block with a fixed memory-type flag and makes two library calls to prepare its fields. It returns the block when the second setup call succeeds; otherwise it frees the block and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:06F6
name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one library routine and returns, passing back nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0714
name: return_zero_without_work
description: Returns zero immediately without performing any work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:071C
name: store_pair_in_counted_table
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter behind the given pointer, refilling the table through a library call when the counter reaches zero or below. It then stores the two arguments into the table entry the counter selects and returns one, or zero if the refill fails.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0744
name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter behind the given pointer and stores two values into the table entry it selects, then returns one. Unlike the neighbouring routine, it never refills the table.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0768
name: allocate_and_fill_header_block
description: Allocates a 94-byte block with a fixed memory-type flag, makes two library calls to set up its contents, and returns the block when the second call succeeds. If either setup step fails, it frees the block and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:07E2
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:07E4
name: call_routine_and_return_zero
description: Calls one library routine, discards its result, and returns zero.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:07FC
name: advance_pointer_and_call
description: Passes the first argument and the second argument advanced by 78 bytes to a library routine, then returns nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0818
name: find_value_in_list
description: Tests each string in a null-terminated list through a library routine and returns the text after the equals sign of the first match. Returns zero when the list is empty or nothing matches.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0836
name: scan_list_for_equals_sign
description: Scans a null-terminated list of strings for an entry whose character at a given position is an equals sign, and returns a pointer to the text after it. Each entry is first passed to a library routine, and zero is returned when the list runs out.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0856
name: find_equals_entry_in_list
description: Walks a null-terminated list of strings, checking each entry through a library call and looking for an equals sign at a given position. It returns a pointer to the text after the sign, or zero when the list ends.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0864
name: search_entry_chain_for_key
description: Walks a chain of entries, using a library call to find each next link, and tests each one with a second library call against a key value. It returns one when an entry passes and zero when the chain ends or the lookup fails.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:087E
name: scan_entry_chain_from_start
description: Iterates through a chain of entries starting from a given value, comparing a value derived from each entry with a target held in a register. It returns one when a match passes a library check and zero when the chain is exhausted.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0896
name: scan_entries_for_target_value
description: Walks a chain of entries, comparing a value derived from each entry with a target value and checking the match with a library call. It returns one when the check succeeds and zero when the chain is exhausted.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:08BE
name: iterate_entries_until_match
description: Steps through entries using a library call that returns each next one, and returns one when an entry's value equals the target and a second library check passes. It returns zero when the chain ends.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:08C8
name: search_chain_for_target
description: Searches a chain of entries from a given start, using library calls to step between entries and to test each candidate. It returns one when a candidate matches the target and zero otherwise.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:08D6
name: parse_copy_count_text
description: Clears a flag byte in the given block and tests the string for a fixed prefix through a library call. If the prefix matches it stores fixed text in the block; otherwise it parses a decimal number from the string and stores text built from it followed by the rest of the string. It returns the block.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0926
name: parse_decimal_field_from_text
description: Reads a decimal number starting at a fixed offset of the given string, and when a following fragment exists, checks it through a library call. It then makes two library cleanup calls and returns nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:0948
name: parse_decimal_and_check_fragment
description: Parses decimal digits from the string pointer, stopping at the first non-digit. If digits were found and the following fragment fails a library check, the routine makes its cleanup calls; both paths then make two library cleanup calls and return nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:094C
name: accumulate_digits_and_cleanup
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the string into a number and then runs one library check on the remaining text. Both branches make two cleanup calls and return nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:09BE
name: convert_digit_char_to_value
description: Returns the numeric value of the character passed in when it is a decimal digit, or minus one for any other character.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:3:09D6
name: return_minus_one_value
description: Returns minus one immediately and performs no other work.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:9:0000
name: call_library_function_slot
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from it. It passes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_library_base_vector
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from it. It passes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_library_base_offset
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from it. It passes no arguments and returns nothing.

description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from it. It passes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_library_entry_point
description: Loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at a fixed negative offset from it. It passes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: attach_handle_or_release
description: Allocates a handle through one library call, then passes that handle with the two arguments to a second call. If the second call fails, the handle is released and zero is returned; otherwise the handle is returned.

name: allocate_counted_buffer_block
description: Allocates a 96-byte block with a fixed memory-type flag, stores the value ten in one of its fields and in the caller's word, then passes the block to a library routine. It returns one when the allocation succeeded and zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_value

name: verify_library_call_result
description: Calls a library routine with three of the arguments and returns that result only when it equals the fourth argument; otherwise it returns zero.

name: verify_routine_call_result
description: Calls a routine with three of the arguments and returns that result only when it equals the fourth argument; otherwise it returns zero.

name: divide_unsigned_32_bit
description: Performs an unsigned 32-bit division, returning the quotient and remainder. Large divisors use a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop, while smaller divisors use direct 16-bit division steps.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:6:0020
name: run_restoring_division_loop
description: Runs the 16-step shift-and-subtract loop of a 32-bit division, shifting the dividend through the high word and subtracting the divisor whenever it fits. It leaves the quotient and remainder in the registers and returns nothing.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:6:0040
name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two register values from 16-bit partial products. It returns that product together with the second operand's halves swapped.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:6:00C8
name: invoke_global_table_entry
description: Calls the function pointer stored at a fixed offset inside a global structure, with no arguments and no result.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:5:0000
name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string and returns the count. It decrements a 16-bit accumulator once per character and returns its bitwise complement, which equals the length.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:5:0010
name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for the given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero if the string ends first.

name: return_zero_without_work

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies a null-terminated string byte by byte from the source to the destination, including the terminating zero byte.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:5:0038
name: append_c_string
description: Finds the terminating zero byte of the destination string, then copies the source string onto that point, including its terminator.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:5:0048
name: compare_c_strings_limited
description: Compares up to the given number of bytes of two strings. It returns one when they differ before the count runs out, and zero when they match or the count is exhausted.

name: return_one_value

name: scan_string_with_limit
description: Walks a null-terminated string for at most the given number of bytes. If the terminator is reached, it makes one library call before returning; otherwise it simply returns.

name: call_routine_then_return

description: Copies a null-terminated string into the destination for up to the given length, then fills any remaining space up to that length with zero bytes.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without performing any operation.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:7:0000
name: initialize_empty_list_header
description: Initialises a list header inside the given block: its first longword points four bytes past the block start, the next longword is cleared, and the following longword points back at the block.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:2:0000
name: check_block_and_forward_field
description: Returns one for a null block pointer. Otherwise it checks the block through a library call sized at twenty bytes and, if that passes, makes two further library calls, one using a field of the block. It returns zero when the check fails.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:2:007A
name: process_block_chain
description: Walks a linked chain of blocks through the next link at a fixed position, calling library routines on each block with its size fields. It returns one when every block succeeds and zero when one fails.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:2:008C
name: run_two_steps_per_block
description: For each block in a linked chain, makes two library calls that must both succeed, then follows the next link at a fixed position. It returns one when the chain ends and zero if a call fails.

key: indiana jones and the last crusade (1989)(lucasfilm games)(disk 1 of 3)/Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)(LucasFilm Games)(Disk 1 of 3).adf:libs/icon.library:2:00D4
name: return_zero_value

name: allocate_and_bind_block
description: Returns zero for a zero count argument. Otherwise it allocates a twenty-byte block with a fixed memory-type flag, sets it up through library calls, and returns the block; if setup fails it returns minus one.
